# Nos Astra

> Nos Astra is an independent software and AI studio in Croatia. It builds websites, custom business tools and practical AI solutions for small businesses.

Founder: Tamara Martinovic, PhD — https://tamara.rocks
Contact: hello@nosastra.co

## Work

- Two business websites
- A custom business application
- A custom company sales presentation
- Welcome Book (https://welcomebook.eu): a QR-code digital guest guide for apartments, villas and holiday homes, used by paying accommodation businesses.

## Notes

Clients work directly with Tamara from the first conversation through to the finished product. Nos Astra starts with the business problem and builds the smallest useful solution.

## Hrvatski

Nos Astra je neovisni softverski i AI studio u Hrvatskoj. Izrađuje web-stranice, prilagođene poslovne alate i praktična AI rješenja za mala poduzeća.

Hrvatska verzija web-stranice dostupna je na https://www.nosastra.co/hr.
